body:
### Summary

related: https://github.com/prefix-dev/pixi/issues/7479

TL;DR: In pixi's mirror feature, there are some cases where PEP 714 may be violated. Specifically, when `index` returns support but the file host does not. In such cases, resolution will fail.

I am requesting the addition of an option that allows forcing a bypass of PEP 714 under certain circumstances to avoid this issue.

### Example

https://github.com/baka-gourd/pixi/blob/feat/disable-pep714/patches/uv-patch.patch
title: Allow UV without using PEP 714/658
